notes.title: Unveiling the Official Key Art for Changer Seven! 🎉
notes.content:
Today, we are unveiling the official key art for Changer Seven! 🎉

Changer Seven is a single-player action-adventure game with exploration, fast-paced dynamic combat, and breathtaking cinematics, where you take control of this group of heroes—a true love letter to the heroes of our childhood. 💙💥

We’ll be at GDC this year, looking for a publisher or investor to help finalize and market the game. Hope to see you there!

This project is our dream coming to life, built with passion and dedication. Every frame, every battle, every moment is crafted with love for gaming and storytelling. Thank you for being part of this journey! 🚀

🇺🇸 Be The Change! ✨

notes.title: Meet Leon Lima: The Dreamer Hero of the Team
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/9737d4c66a82bed32728ea0d1b14073a9a953b7b.png[/img]

Leon is the dreamer and vibrant soul of the team. A fan of anime and tokusatsu series, especially the legendary 'Teenage Morphing Capybara Samurai', he always wanted to be more than just the funny nerd. For him, becoming a Changer was the realization of a dream: the chance to be a real hero.

Wielding the spear, a symbol of bravery and determination, Leon is the most enthusiastic member of the team. His transformations are a true spectacle, with dramatic poses, fervent speeches, and catchphrases that not only inspire but also bring plenty of laughs from his teammates. He also has a quirky habit: he loves giving names to the enemies he faces, justifying it with “great villains deserve great names!”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/6107950a46eb2918b95cb654cf3ec2bbe95bced1.png[/img]

Behind all the enthusiasm, Leon carries a secret: his life outside the battles is marked by difficulties. Coming from a troubled home, where constant fights between his parents make him feel neglected, he finds in the role of Changer a refuge and an opportunity to be seen and valued.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/e1dc00a3042bf4bc653857654994d1081722fb2c.png[/img]

Leon is the team’s optimistic spirit, the friend who never lets anyone stay down, and the hero who turns every battle into an epic adventure. His energy and passion make him the spark that lights up the team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/5dc6bc341d3e80470d7b40a3e423909deaa747dd.jpg[/img]

In his gameplay mechanics, we are testing a new hook that can be fired from the tip of his spear to reach areas other Changers can’t. He’s a very interesting, fun character, and we believe he will become one of the most beloved by Changer Seven fans.

notes.title: Meet Changer Blue: Mariana Silva
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/6ca67f70f226a6aad336c9da46c30048f62b6b03.png[/img]

When you first meet Mariana Silva, her impressive height of 1.76m and athletic build might be intimidating. However, she is a kind-hearted girl who would do anything for her friends. 💪

As Changer Blue, Mari is the protective soul of the team, and her shield is the perfect extension of her calm and thoughtful nature. This is no ordinary shield; it’s a multifunctional weapon that embodies Mari’s strength and versatility.

Equipped with a turbine propeller beneath its surface, the Blue Shield can amplify the speed and power of Mari’s punches, making her an even more formidable fighter. Additionally, the shield can be thrown like a boomerang, always returning to her hand after striking enemies. But its true standout feature is its ability to spin continuously, hitting foes multiple times in a devastating attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/8bcbc3f49a2be8ff2832cf9326c6bbb5555ec007.png[/img]

Carrying the shield is not just a strategic choice for Mari; it’s a responsibility she takes on with unwavering dedication. As the most sensible and protective member of her friends, she knows her role is to safeguard the team, and the Blue Shield is the tool that enables her to fulfill this duty with excellence.

As the protective soul of the team, Mari wields the Blue Shield – not just an ordinary shield but a multifunctional weapon that mirrors her strength and versatility.

With the turbine propeller enhancing her strikes, the Blue Shield ensures Mari stands as a formidable defender of her allies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/97ae18551e3231ea011e70bf2446326ac14c81d0.png[/img]

notes.title: Meet Rubi Valente: The Powerful Leader of the Changer Seven
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/a8027a21e9237f4b2651de4584b74105ece3e3ba.jpg[/img]

In the world of superheroes, leaders are often figures of strength, charisma, and courage. In the universe of Changer Seven, this responsibility rests on the shoulders of Ruby Valente, the Changer Red. Inspired by the tradition of Super Sentai series, where the red hero frequently takes the central role, Ruby stands out not only for her abilities but also for her unique and fiery personality.

Ruby Valente is an active, curious teenager with a sharp sense of humor—just be careful not to become the target of her jokes! Her impetuous and sometimes irritable temperament makes her an unpredictable leader, but it’s precisely this vibrant energy that makes her the heart of the team. Ruby is always the first to take the initiative, and although her decisions can be hasty, her undeniable charisma often leads others to follow her.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/e870b6739b7df462412847b10a22464f25c33dba.jpg[/img]

Much like the precious stone that shares her name, Ruby is intense and of rare beauty, carrying the symbolism of passion, love, and power. These elements not only define her personality but also guide her actions as the leader of the Changers. Though her approach may be impulsive at times, the raw strength of her spirit molds her into a natural leader, even if she is still in the process of being polished.

Her laid-back and somewhat tomboyish demeanor, which at first may not seem fitting for a leader, hides vast potential. The time and experiences she will face alongside her fellow Changers will be essential in transforming this rough stone into one of the most valuable gems of the group.

Ruby Valente represents what it means to be a young leader in evolution: she makes mistakes, learns, grows, and becomes stronger with each challenge faced. At the heart of Changer Seven, she is the flame that never goes out, illuminating the path for her companions with her unwavering courage and an indomitable will.

If you resonate with heroes who have flaws but fight tirelessly to overcome them, then Ruby Valente is the character you've been waiting for. She reminds us that sometimes the most effective leaders are not those who start out perfect, but those who have the courage to become who they need to be.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/6096969fba6b5af6dc3ad1a38bf0b90c966c9b4e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Changer Seven: Inspiration and What Makes It Unique
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/2ec0327335e455ceaad92a9220b56093155112a9.png[/img]

Changer Seven is a vibrant tribute to the tokusatsu style, a Japanese genre that combines live-action, impressive special effects, and superhero stories. Tokusatsu, which literally means "special effects film," is known for its series and films featuring heroes in elaborate costumes, choreographed battles, and eccentric villains. This style has significantly influenced the creation of Changer Seven, shaping not only its visual aesthetics but also its narrative and gameplay mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/4e59f55452bac91971cdb584b8a52ffefd4c8ab1.png[/img]

[b]Tokusatsu Style and Its Influence on Game Design[/b]

The tokusatsu genre emerged in the 1950s in Japan, with the groundbreaking film "Godzilla" (Gojira), released in 1954, often credited as its starting point. Directed by Ishirō Honda and produced by Toho Company, this film established many of the concepts and styles defining tokusatsu, such as using special effects to create monsters and sci-fi scenarios.

However, the inspiration for Changer Seven came from a subcategory of tokusatsu: Super Sentai. Super Sentai refers to a specific series within the tokusatsu genre, characterized by a team of colorful heroes fighting villains and monsters, often using special suits and transforming into powerful warriors.

Super Sentai began with "Himitsu Sentai Gorenger" in 1975, produced by Toei Company and created by the manga master Shotaro Ishinomori, who would later create Kamen Rider. With 84 episodes, Gorenger is considered one of the greatest Super Sentai works and introduced the concept of a team of heroes with colorful suits and special abilities that transform to combat evil. This concept influenced numerous series in Japan and was later exported to various countries, including Brazil, which had access to these series in the 1990s, starting with Jaspion. This is the major inspiration behind Changer Seven.

In Changer Seven, each character has a superhero identity manifested through a spectacular transformation. The design of the suits is meticulously crafted to reflect each hero's personality and powers, visually impressive and evoking the vibrant and colorful aesthetics of Japanese series. The game’s settings are inspired by the urban landscapes of Brazil’s diverse capitals, combined with fantastical environments where the battle between good and evil unfolds on a grand scale.

[b]Narrative and Themes[/b]

The narrative of Changer Seven incorporates classic tokusatsu elements such as fighting a global threat, the importance of teamwork, and the concept of sacrifice for the greater good. The story explores universal themes of friendship, courage, and justice, featuring a plot that is both thrilling and reflective. The episodic structure of the narrative pays homage to the Super Sentai format with its "monster of the week" approach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/869f6da8a377d3f89bd63697bee2ef0113114fd1.jpg[/img]

[b]Action and Choreography[/b]

The action scenes in Changer Seven are inspired by intense and acrobatic fight choreography captured using motion capture technology. Every move, jump, and special attack comes from a real person. The use of these visual effects is designed to enhance the gaming experience, providing players with a sense of power and excitement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/81dc995743d22e5e7d739d0d3834353e64d10f54.jpg[/img]

[b]What Makes Changer Seven Unique?[/b]

Changer Seven is not just a tribute to tokusatsu style but a modern reimagining that blends traditional elements with contemporary innovations and Brazilian culture. The game stands out with its innovative gameplay mechanics, allowing players to explore different combat styles and strategies through quick character switching.

In summary, Changer Seven is a celebration of tokusatsu style adapted for the modern gaming audience, offering a unique experience that is both familiar and new. It is an epic journey where players can transform into heroes and embark on unforgettable adventures.

notes.title: Changer Seven Shines at Gamescom Latam 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/1dc048b6be2c0d875edb4f5f10099bc1e31fd761.jpg[/img]

From June 26 to 30, Gamescom Latam took place, and for the first time, we were able to showcase the gameplay of Changer Seven. The audience loved it, and we received very positive feedback. We're back to development with renewed energy to keep working on the game.

One of the most important aspects of creating a game is putting it in the hands of players. It's through them that we learn what works and what doesn't. The single-player gameplay mechanics, where players can combine combos by switching heroes, were very well received by the audience.

Now, we're back to crafting and finalizing the next stages of our story.

Stay tuned with us! This news channel will be updated with any new developments as soon as they happen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43685939/bca33b55302e9427656722de31577d9726fe619d.jpg[/img]
